sections.label: Pallavi
sections.ta:
ஏழுமலை ஏறி வந்தேன் எம்பெருமானே எந்தன்
ஊழுவினை தீர்த்திடுவாய் சீனிவாசப் பெருமானே
sections.translit:
Ezhumalai ERi vandhEn emperumAnE endhan
Uzhuvinai thIrtthiduvAi sInivAsap perumAnE
sections.en: Lord Srinivasa, I climbed all seven hills to reach you.  Please remove all my past sins.

sections.label: Anupallavi
sections.ta:
மஞ்சத் துணியில் காசு முடிஞ்சு வந்தேன் எந்தன்
நெஞ்சில் நிறஞ்சதெல்லாம் நல்லா நடக்குமுன்னு
sections.translit:
manjath thuNiyil kAsu mudinju vandhEn endhan
nenjil niRanjadhellAm nallA nadakkumunnu
sections.en: I brought coins packaged in a traditional turmeric-soaked cloth, as well as my prayers to have my wishes fulfilled.

sections.label: Charanam
sections.ta:
பிடிச்சிப்போன நம்ம அம்மா கையைப் பிடிச்சிடவே
காசில்லாம நீ தவிச்ச கதையைக் கேட்டுப்புட்டேன்
அடச்சீ நமக்கு மட்டும் இம்மாம் பணம் ஏதுக்கின்னு
உடமை எல்லாம் வித்துப்புட்டு உன் கடனடைக்க நானும்
sections.translit:
pidicchippOna namma ammA kaiyaip pidicchidavE
kAsillAma nI thaviccha kadhaiyaik kettupputtEn
adacchI namakku mattum immAm paNam Edhukkinnu
udamai ellAm vitthupputtu un kadanadaikka nAnum
sections.en: I just heard about your predicament. I heard that you did not have enough money to marry the lady that you liked at first sight. I understood the gravity of your plight and wondered why I am holding on to this much property while you suffer. So I sold all my property to settle your loans and climbed the seven hills to reach you.

notes: Venkateswara borrowing money from Kubera, the god of wealth, to wed Padmavathi in the Tirumala Hills, is a well-known story. In brief, based on the commitment that Venkateswara made with the lender, he must pay back the entire amount with interest before he is allowed to return to his abode, Vaikuntam. This is the reason why devotees to this day offer their wealth to the Lord in Thiruppathi. It is also a tradition to pray to Venkateswara after a bath, and tie some coins in a turmeric soaked cloth, and deposit the money in a vault within the Tiruppathi shrine. This is typically done when a family member is in ill health, or to pray that a joyous event such as a wedding goes without obstacles. For details, see: Devotees offer gold and cash to Srinivasa to pay off His loan
